question: Prepare my renewal conversation and deck. Fictional CIR — A Facts: Synthetic K-12 District Alpha, K-12, urban, 8,400 students, 1,050 staff. B Facts: EES SYN-EES-1001, A3 9,450, expires 2027-06-30. C Facts: use 42%, endpoint adoption 28%, security not evaluated. D Insight: adoption is low. Supporting Fact: Teams varies by school. E Signal: risk Medium; expansion evidence insufficient. F Fact: mission unavailable.

question: Prepare my renewal conversation. Fictional CIR — A Facts: Synthetic K-12 District Beta, K-12, suburban, 21,300 students, 2,700 staff. question: Create a renewal deck; no prior strategy exists. Fictional CIR — A Facts: Synthetic K-12 District Gamma, K-12, rural; students and staff unavailable.
